description: Replace the complete manual app price schedule. Call apple_get_pricing first and include every current and future manual price entry that must be preserved.

baseTerritoryId.description: Base territory ID for that price point, e.g. USA

manualPrices.description: Complete desired manual schedule, including existing entries that must remain

appPricePointId.description: App Price Point ID returned by apple_list_app_price_points

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD, or null for an open-ended entry

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD, or null for the current entry

name: apple_set_price
